name: Pictory
tagline: Pictory is an AI video creation platform that turns blog posts, scripts, or text prompts into polished short videos automatically. It matches relevant stock footage from a library of millions of clips to your words, adds subtitles, background music, and a voiceover, then exports a shareable video. Content marketers and eLearning teams use Pictory to repurpose written content into video without any editing skills.
